rows.summary: Between 2017 and 2025, Blue Martini's Item 11 changed the estimated pre-opening period from 12 to 18 months, converted the local advertising spend from a recommended 2% to a required 3% of Gross Revenues, added lost-Manual and additional-training fees, replaced Aloha-specific POS cost disclosures with a generic system estimated at $10,000-$20,000 initial cost plus a $1,200/month supplier fee, and removed or narrowed several franchisor pricing, cooperative, council, site-assistance, and day-to-day assistance provisions.
